svg.title: Step 1 reads the band once per color
svg.desc: An eight by six band of sky, sun and grass. The encoder scans all pixels three times and writes #0NN^^^NKK then $#1!6?BB then $#2oo___ooo.
svg.text: Step 1 reads the band once per color
Three colors means three passes over the same 48 pixels.
A photograph with 216 colors needs 216 passes per band.
